title: Dip scanner JSON API v1
description: The responses of the Fly.io app's JSON API under /api/v1, which the Next.js front end reads. One definition per endpoint response in $defs; x-endpoints maps each endpoint to its definition. Conventions: numbers are JSON numbers, never formatted strings; moments are ISO 8601 date-times with an offset (UTC), calendar days are YYYY-MM-DD; amounts are in the idea's trading currency (`currency`, as Yahoo quotes it: USD, EUR, GBp for pence...) with `approx` the same amount in the reader's currency at the rate in `fx` (null when nothing is converted); percentages are numbers of percent (-3.3 means -3.3%). Every property of the computed (view) objects is always present: null (or an empty list) stands for missing data. Raw records (Opportunity, PriceStats, Analysis, Debate) are Opportunity.to_dict() and may carry more keys.

TradingCurrency.description: The currency a price is quoted in, as Yahoo Finance gives it: USD, EUR, HKD, and minor units such as GBp or GBX (pence), ZAc (cents), ILA (agorot).

CurrencyCode.description: An ISO 4217 currency a reader chose (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF...).

ScoreBand.description: report.SCORE_BANDS: 80+ strong, 65-80 good, 50-65 fair, under 50 weak (by the unrounded score).

DebateMode.description: debate: openings, rebuttals and a judge; agreed: the openings agreed and were merged; single: one model only (the other failed, reason says why).

Money.description: An amount in the idea's trading currency, and about the same in the reader's currency (fx) or null when nothing is converted (no currency chosen, the same currency, or no known rate).

Fx.description: The exchange rate behind every `approx` amount of an idea.

currency.description: The reader's currency (approx amounts are in it).

rate.description: Units of `currency` per unit of the trading currency as quoted (per penny for GBp): approx = amount * rate.

main_currency.description: The trading currency's main unit (GBP for GBp).

rate_main_unit.description: Units of `currency` per main unit (1 GBP, not 1 penny).

source.description: analysis: stored with the analysis; today: fetched today because none was stored.

as_of.description: When the rate was taken: the analysis's time, or when today's rate was fetched.

note.description: report.fx_text, e.g. "1 USD = 0.8778 EUR at the analysis (Yahoo Finance); your broker's rate and conversion fee differ".

Error.description: Every error of /api/v1, with the HTTP status of the code: not_signed_in 401; forbidden, csrf, origin 403; not_found 404; method_not_allowed 405; bad_request 400 or 422; rate_limited and limit_reached 429 (with a Retry-After header too); unavailable 503; server_error 500.

message.description: A sentence for people, safe to show (no technical details).

retry_after.description: Seconds until trying again makes sense (429), else null.

Me.description: GET /api/v1/me: who is signed in, their settings, the session's CSRF token (send it as X-CSRF-Token with every POST, and as the csrf_token field of HTML forms such as POST /logout) and what they may do.

label.description: The name, or the email address when there is none (User.label).

currency.description: Currency of the approx amounts; null: trading currency only.

timezone.description: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Athens: show every time in it.

has_alert_channel.description: UserSettings.has_channel: email, Telegram or a webhook is set up.

available.description: The reader may start one now.

limit.description: Manual analyses allowed in 24 hours; null: no limit (admins).

remaining.description: Left in the last 24 hours; null: no limit.

note.description: Why not, when available is false.

reason.description: Why it is stopped, off or stalled.

next_cycle_at.description: Only while running or paused and no cycle runs.

feeds.description: Feeds that answered in the last cycle; null before the first cycle.

model_today.description: The language model's use since 00:00 UTC (every step and model together).

DebateSummary.description: One line about the debate behind an idea, for lists.

line.description: The chat alerts' line: "GPT-5 72% · Claude 58% → 64% (medium agreement)".

judge.description: provider:model; null when no judge ran.

IdeaSummary.description: An idea (an opportunity) with the numbers the pages show, computed for the reader: their currency, watchlist and alert rules.

age_seconds.description: Seconds from created to the response's generated_at.

verdict_label.description: report.verdict_label: Temporary fear, Mixed, Fundamental damage, Unclear.

entry_upside_pct.description: Target vs the entry: what the two limit orders would make.

analyses_count.description: Analyses of this ticker: in the list's period (list), or stored (detail).

superseded.description: A newer analysis of the ticker exists.

superseded_by.description: The newest analysis's id when superseded.

on_my_watchlist.description: The ticker is on the reader's watchlist (through preferred_listings).

debate.description: null in single-model mode and for records from before debates.

IdeasList.description: GET /api/v1/ideas?days=7&min_score=65&verdict=temporary_fear&watchlist=1&matching=1&sort=score&page=1: the newest analysis of every ticker analysed in the last `days` days, filtered, ranked, a page at a time (25). Unknown or invalid values fall back to the defaults (days 7, no filters, sort score, page 1) and are echoed in filters.

matching.description: Only ideas that pass the reader's alert rules.

total.description: Ideas (one per ticker) in the period before the filters.

count.description: Ideas that pass the filters (all pages).

Analysis.description: models.analysis_to_dict: one analyst's (or the final) position.

Debate.description: DEBATE_SPEC Debate (raw, as stored in Opportunity.debate).

reason.description: Why single, or why no judge ran.

favoured.description: provider:model of the favoured analyst, or null (neither).

DebateParticipantView.description: A Participant plus its labels for people.

model_label.description: Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5...; with the service in brackets when both debaters' models would read the same.

provider_label.description: The service: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure AI Foundry.

other_label.description: The other debater's model_label; null when it stood alone.

critique.description: Where it says the other analyst is wrong.

concessions.description: What it accepts from the other analyst.

favoured.description: The judge found its case stronger.

compare.description: A rebuttal ran, so its opening is shown next to its final position.

DebateView.description: The Debate of an idea with labels and texts for people (the idea page's Debate card), worded as on the Fly idea page (pages.debate_view).

reason_label.description: reason as a sentence for people, with model names instead of provider:model labels.

title.description: The card's heading: "The models" when one model stood alone.

how.description: How the debate went, in a sentence; null when one model stood alone (reason_label says why).

summary.description: The judge's debate_summary, or the generated line of an agreed merge.

favoured_label.description: model_label of the favoured analyst; null: neither.

ruling_title.description: The heading of the outcome's box: "The ruling by Claude Sonnet 5", "The merged analysis", "Merged by rule, without a judge"; null when one model stood alone.

judge_note.description: Whose case the judge found stronger and what it knew; null without a judge.

PriceStats.description: models.stats_to_dict (raw; only the keys the pages use are required).

Headline.description: A stored headline (raw). The link is shown only when it is an http(s) URL.

model.description: e.g. gpt-5, or "debate: gpt-5 vs claude-sonnet-5, judged by claude-sonnet-5".

Level.description: A row of the levels card, highest value first.

label.description: Target (limit sell idea), Price in the report, Entry (limit buy), Statistical 6-month low, Potential low.

short_label.description: Target, Reported, Entry, Stat. low, Low (the chart's labels).

change_pct.description: From the price in the report; null for the price itself.

from_entry_pct.description: From the entry, for target and potential_low; null for the others.

Chart.description: About 6 months of daily closes up to today (from a few weeks before an older report), and the idea's levels. After a split since the report, closes are Yahoo's split-adjusted ones and the levels are divided by split_factor to match.

signal_day.description: The report's day on the exchange's calendar (track.signal_day): the marker sits there at levels.reported.

Outcome.description: track.evaluate with the benchmark index and the reader's currency. Returns are null until something traded since the report (priced false), and when unknown.

status_label.description: track.STATUS_LABELS: waiting for entry, open, target hit, below the low, expired.

price_mismatch.description: The report's price doesn't match Yahoo's history: nothing can be measured.

trade_return_pct.description: Entry to target (when hit) or the last close; null when the entry never filled.

HistoryItem.description: An analysis of the same ticker, for the timeline.

current.description: This is the idea the page shows.

IdeaDetail.description: GET /api/v1/ideas/{id}: everything the idea page shows. Price history is cached for an hour.

fx_note.description: The rate behind the approx amounts, or why there are none ("No USD/EUR rate is known, so the amounts are in USD only"); null when the reader has no other currency.

prices_problem.description: Why there is no chart or outcome (the price history couldn't be loaded).

outcome_notes.description: The index or the exchange rates couldn't be loaded.

history.description: Every analysis of the ticker (at most 50), newest first, this one included.

rule_misses.description: pages.rule_misses: why it wouldn't alert the reader; [] when it would.

ReanalyseAccepted.description: POST /api/v1/ideas/{id}/reanalyse (header X-CSRF-Token, no body): HTTP 202, a manual analysis of the idea's ticker was queued. Errors: 403 csrf/origin, 404, 429 limit_reached or rate_limited, 503 unavailable.

Job.description: GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}: a manual analysis (only its owner, or an admin, may read it; 404 otherwise). Poll every few seconds until done or failed.

remaining.description: The reader's manual analyses left in 24 hours; null: no limit.

ThesisChanges.description: GET /api/v1/thesis-changes?days=7 (1-30, default 7): newer analyses that undercut an earlier idea that passed the reader's rules (pages.thesis_changes), newest first.

reason.description: "no longer passes your alert rules", "its chance of being higher fell by 22 points".
